messages:
maria (docs): Heads up — customers are hitting breakage when swapping the older embed model to the new v2 embed in our examples. vectors changed from 128 -> 256 and snippets don't handle it.
aj (sdk): Oof. Which examples exactly?
maria (docs): onboarding/embeddings.md + quickstarts/js/embedding-snippet.md and a few user guides. Repro: run the snippet, cosine similarity suddenly drops because the dims mismatch.
kevin (eng): We intentionally changed the default model variant for better quality. We did add a compatibility alias but docs still point to the old model id.
sara (pm): Priority: low/medium but visible to customers. Can we patch docs ASAP and add a migration note? Also need a small SDK guard.
aj (sdk): I can add a client-side check that throws a friendly error if the embedding length != expected. Patch will be tiny. Proposed code: 
```js
const v = await client.embeddings.create(...);
if (v.data[0].embedding.length !== 256) {
  throw new Error('Embedding dimension mismatch: expected 256. See docs: /docs/migrate/embed-dim');
}
```
maria (docs): Nice. Can you include suggested text we can paste? Also update sample outputs so CI smoke tests pass.
aj (sdk): Will do. Text: "Some v2 embed models return 256-dim vectors (previously 128). If you rely on vector dimensions (indexes, similarity thresholds), update preprocessing and index schemas. See migration steps below."
kevin (eng): I'll add an alias that maps the v1 id to the new model for 2 weeks to give space. I'll also add an opt-in config on the model server to keep returning 128-d vectors (quantized projection) for legacy clients — engineering PR incoming.
sara (pm): Great. Docs action items: 1) Add migration callout at top of embeddings.md, 2) Update JS/TS snippets + outputs, 3) Link to SDK error and engineering opt-in, 4) Add brief note in changelog.
maria (docs): I'll open a PR with the callout and updated snippets. Draft text in PR description and mark as WIP. 
(maria posts) PR: https://git.redwood/infr/docs/pull/4829 (WIP)
aj (sdk): I'll open SDK PR that adds the check and unit test: https://git.redwood/infr/sdk/pull/2101. Will reference docs PR.
kevin (eng): My backend PR: https://git.redwood/infr/serving/pull/7450 — will keep alias for two weeks. Add note to changelog entry saying alias will be removed after 2026-04-15.
maria (docs): Filing a small smoke test update ticket for CI: Migrate sample vector length assertions to 256 where appropriate — JIRA INF-1723.
docs-bot: Reminder: label updates needed — add labels "docs/migration", "urgent?" to PR 4829.
sara (pm): Who's owning the changelog entry?
maria (docs): I'll add it.
aj (sdk): ETA for SDK patch: EOD tomorrow. I'll attach the exact error message so docs can copy it verbatim.
maria (docs): Perfect. I'll wait for the exact string before merging. If the backend opt-in isn't ready, we'll keep a clear note that the alias exists temporarily.
kevin (eng): Noted. I'll ping infra to expedite the alias rollout.
sara (pm): OK team — thanks. small plan, high visibility. Please keep this thread updated with PR links and final error text. :thumbsup:
